messages:
lena: AtlasHealth pinged — invoice INV-2026-410 looks like it was billed in USD instead of EUR. They were expecting EUR pricing. Can we reconcile?
omar: Can you paste the top lines or screenshot?
lena: Link: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-410. Snippet:
```
Item: Reserved Dedicated (monthly)   €1,200.00
Currency charged: USD                    $1,350.00
Exchange rate used: 1.1250 (we usually use daily mid-rate)
```
billing-bot: Alert: currency_mismatch_detector triggered for INV-2026-410. Detected invoice currency != account billing currency (acct: EUR). Flagged for finance review.
omar: Looks like our billing pipeline applied a USD charging path. If we correct to EUR the charge difference is about $150. Recommend issuing a cross-currency adjustment credit equivalent to $150, and update invoice to show EUR totals. Accounting code: ACCT-FX-ADJ.
claire: If approximation is ~$150 that's above auto-credit threshold ($100). Manager approval required. I can approve after confirming amount.
lena: Customer on record (acct ATL-492) requests a refund for the overage and updated invoice. They want an official credit memo.
omar: I'll compute exact FX delta using the invoice rate. Command: `/billing compute-fx-delta INV-2026-410 --target-currency EUR`
omar: Output: `FX delta = $147.52 (credit equivalent to €131.14 at applied rate).`
claire: Approve manual credit: Claire (finance manager) approves €131.14 / $147.52 as FX adjustment. Mark reason: "currency mis-bill (USD charged instead of EUR)".
omar: Applying: `/billing create-credit INV-2026-410 --amount 147.52 --currency USD --acct ACCT-FX-ADJ --reason "currency mis-bill" --approved-by claire`
omar: System: `Success: credit CR-2026-801 created; invoice updated to reflect EUR totals; ledger LB-2026-120 appended.`
billing-bot: Audit: CR-2026-801 applied to INV-2026-410; note "FX adjustment per manager approval; corrected to EUR billing".
support: Notified AtlasHealth via SUP-49234: "We've applied a credit of €131.14 (CR-2026-801) and updated invoice INV-2026-410. Please review and confirm."
lena: Customer replied "thanks, saw updated invoice and credit". Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
